import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create a sample DataFrame with string user_id and float64 score
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [1.5, 2.7, 3.14]
})

# Convert using narwhals
df_nw = nw.from_native(df)
df_converted = df_nw.select([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
])

# Return as native DataFrame
result = df_converted.to_native()
print(result)
print(result.dtypes)
